_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6: Grimgrin, the type 4E bullet, It's stub ($93DC-$960B). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): first frame?
regions.description: The type in Y; an initialised object (bit 7) goes to `$9419`. Table stats: flags `$5A`, dies as type 7, art block `$1C`; **`$48`: hit points 56 x 16 = 896, attack 64; `$49`: 88 x 16 = 1,408, attack 96.**

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): its parameters
regions.description: The attribute := `$8FEA[type]` (palette 2 for `$48`, 0 for `$49`) and the phase step `$07D0` := `$9586[type]` (`$30` / `$40`: a phase every 5 / 4 frames).

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): art and hit points
regions.description: `JSR $C0A8`, `JSR $C165`.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): set-up
regions.description: y target `$0668` := `$68`, x target `$0680` := `$80`, y := `$30`, x := `$C0`, metasprite `$40` (the body), the phase cleared, the timer `$0788` := `$78`, **the state `$07A0` := `$9F`** (bit 7 = the entrance, bits 4, 3, 2, 1, 0 = the pieces on).

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): entrance?
regions.description: State bit 7 clear goes on to the fight (`$9438`).

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the entrance
regions.description: `DEC $0788`; at 0 **the state := `$1F`** (the fight begins); otherwise the body is drawn on every second frame only (`$942A`).

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the entrance: flicker
regions.description: Drawn when the timer's bit 0 is set (`$C090`, then the pieces); even values return. RUN: the entrance lasts 120 frames (`$9F` -> `$1F` at frame 119).

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the palette flip
regions.description: `LDA #7 / JSR $9B09`: the attribute's bit 6 flipped every 8th frame.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the last stage?
regions.description: State bit 5 (`$20`): draw only where the frame counter `$41` is 0 or move and draw; skip the stage logic.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): move
GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the stages by hit points
regions.description: **The high part of the hit points `$0740`: 3 or more: nothing; 2: the state := `$1C`; 1: `$10`; 0: `$0740` := 1, attribute 1 and the state := `$20`.** So as it is hurt the pieces switch off: all five (>= 768 hit points), then two, then one, then none. RUN: the states `$1F` -> `$1C` -> `$10` -> `$20` as `$0740` is set to 2, 1, 0.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the phase
regions.description: `JSR $C0A5` with A = `$07D0` (the step), Y = `$1C`: the phase `$0638` 0-27.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the lower piece
regions.description: State bit 4 clear: metasprite `$44`; set: by the phase, `$42 $43 $42` for phases 8-10 (the mouth opens), otherwise `$41`; stored in `$17` and drawn.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): draw it
regions.description: `JSR $C093`; the attribute reduced to its palette bits.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the middle pair
regions.description: State bit 2 clear: `$4A`; set: `$49` for phases 14-16, otherwise `$48`; kept in `$15` and drawn.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the upper pair
regions.description: State bit 0 clear: `$47`; set: `$46` for phases 24-26, otherwise `$45`; kept in `$14` and drawn.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the mirrored halves
regions.description: The attribute's bit 6 toggled and the two pairs drawn again: **each pair is drawn twice, mirrored.**

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): no fire in the entrance
regions.description: State bit 7 returns.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): once a phase
regions.description: Only on the first frame of a phase (the fraction `$0650` under the step).

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): what the lower piece says
regions.description: `$44` (state bit 4 clear) goes to the fragments; `$41` to the eye volley (`$9549`); anything else (the mouth `$42` / `$43` open) to an aimed shot.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the mouth: an aimed shot
regions.description: A free slot; a type-`$0B` aimed shot (`$C105`) at the boss's place.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the last stage: fragments
regions.description: A lobbed type-`$2A` fragment (`$BF61`); on odd phases it takes the variant fields (`$07B8` = `$0728` = 4, attribute 3, metasprite `$1A`, `$07A0` := 0). RUN: type-`$2A` fragments every phase in the `$20` state.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): to the hit test
regions.description: `JMP $95BD`.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the eye volley (`$9549`)
regions.description: **The middle pair at its widest (`$15` = `$49`) and phase 14 selects the UPPER eyes (offsets index 0); the upper pair at `$46` and phase 24 the LOWER eyes (index 4).** The direction to the player `$16`; two bullets: the type is `$4E` for `$48` and alternates `$4E` / `$27` (`$AD9A`) for `$49`, each made at the boss + the eye offset (`$95C3`), heading = the aim, `$07A0` := 4 (kind 4 for the `$27`). RUN: `$48` makes `$4E` bullets (10 in 500 frames), `$49` `$4E` and `$27` alike; with the state `$1C` the volley is cut, with `$10` only the mouth's `$0B` shots remain.

regions.name: GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): the hit test
regions.description: `JSR $C0C6` and `JMP $C0D8` (the boss rules).

regions.name: Grimgrin's eye offsets
Grimgrin's mouth pictures
regions.description: `42 43 42`, indexed by the phase 8-10.

regions.name: Grimgrin's phase step by type
GRIMGRIN, types `$48` / `$49` (corridors 18 and 8; bank 6 `$93DC`): move (`$95D0`)
regions.description: The y spring (acceleration `$18`) toward y `$68` and the x spring (`$10`) toward x `$80`, `JMP $C08D`: it hovers about (128, 104).

regions.name: TYPE `$4E`, an aimed bullet (bank 6 `$95DD`): first frame
regions.description: Flags 0, hit points 16, attack 24, drawing flags `$13`, art block 4, dies as type 8. First frame: the art wait, attribute 0, **speed class `$41` (1.9 px a frame) along the heading `$0788` the shooter gave** (`$C102`), the phase cleared.

regions.name: TYPE `$4E`: every frame
regions.description: The phase counter (A = `$60`, Y = 8: a phase per 3 frames, 0-7) drives the picture through `$A1CB`; then the common move and hit test (`JMP $9F4F`: `$C08D`, `$C0C6`, `$C0D2`).

regions.name: IT's stub (bank 6 `$9605`)
regions.description: `JSR $C006` with `01 0B 80` (bank 1 `$800C` -> `$82B5`): the handler of type `$4F`, It (see the bank 1 entry).

regions.name: IT's stub: return
regions.description: `RTS`.
